full_text: Here’s to all “teacher/parents” out there. I can’t imagine what it would have been like if my father (RIP) had to be my math/English/music teacher. Rock on. #homeschooling with Dad.#covid19 #stayhome @ Canton,… https://t.co/Kdsx931wbM
